eligible.name: Subnautica 2
eligible.short_description: Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.

eligible.name: Forza Horizon 6
eligible.short_description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.

eligible.name: Far Far West
eligible.short_description: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

eligible.name: Windrose
eligible.short_description: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

eligible.name: Crimson Desert
eligible.short_description: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.

eligible.name: Gamble With Your Friends
eligible.short_description: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.

eligible.name: Dead as Disco
eligible.short_description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

eligible.name: PRAGMATA
eligible.short_description: Pragmata is a unique, sci-fi action-adventure game from Capcom. Follow Hugh, a member of an ill-fated investigation team, and Diana, a young android, as they navigate a lunar facility taken over by rogue AI in search of a way to Earth.

eligible.name: Slay the Spire 2
eligible.short_description: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

eligible.name: Resident Evil Requiem
eligible.short_description: Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living. Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.

eligible.name: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era
eligible.short_description: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Raise grand armies and wield devastating spells to overcome your foes in both solo and multiplayer.

eligible.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
eligible.short_description: Join private investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. MOUSE combines the charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1930’s with the adrenaline and action of an explosive first person shooter.

eligible.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
eligible.short_description: The Animal Evolution Roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge and Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from 125+ Evolutions and Specialisations for unique creature combinations in every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

eligible.name: Farever
eligible.short_description: Forge your legend in a forgotten realm! Farever is an online multiplayer action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world. Alone or with friends, embark on an epic journey together! Explore wild lands and dangerous dungeons, craft powerful gear, and carve your path through dynamic combat and platforming.

eligible.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
eligible.short_description: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

eligible.name: Invincible VS
eligible.short_description: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

eligible.name: Marathon
eligible.short_description: Scavenge the lost colony of Tau Ceti IV as a bio-cybernetic Runner in a PvPvE survival extraction FPS from the creators of Halo and Destiny.

eligible.name: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
eligible.short_description: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

eligible.name: Super Battle Golf
eligible.short_description: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

eligible.name: REPLACED
eligible.short_description: Follow R.E.A.C.H., an AI trapped in a human body, on a cinematic adventure through an alternate 1980s America. Explore an atmospheric cyberpunk world full of high-stakes action wrapped in a unique 2.5D pixel art style.

eligible.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
eligible.short_description: From the creators of Vampire Survivors comes a turbo-charged, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder! Deal world-ending combos, blitz through infested dungeons, and master the Turboturn to obliterate hordes of familiar foes with a chaotic hand of cards.

eligible.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
eligible.short_description: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

eligible.name: Outbound
eligible.short_description: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

eligible.name: Everwind
eligible.short_description: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

eligible.name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
eligible.short_description: <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> is an open-world anime RPG set in the universe of [The Seven Deadly Sins]. Step into the role of Prince Tristan of Liones and explore an open-world Britannia, as you embark on a journey to restore order to a world thrown into chaos by the collision of time and space.

eligible.name: Deephold
eligible.short_description: A tactical dwarven tower defense. Forge runes onto 7 tower types, unlock commander skills, and hold your gates through 12 campaign levels and an endless gauntlet. No ads, no micro-transactions, no always-online. Buy once, play forever.

eligible.name: SiNiSistar 2
eligible.short_description: Step into a beautifully somber pixel art world of decay filled with grotesque, writhing abominations...A dark action RPG that follows the journey of a demon-slaying nun who must resist destruction and despair while purging the corruption from this world one boss after another!

eligible.name: Sic Bo Macau: The Ultimate Casino Dice Game
eligible.short_description: Casino-grade Sic Bo simulator with real payout tables — Standard, Macau, Atlantic City, Australia, and Super with multipliers up to 1000×. Infinite virtual chips, zero microtransactions. Built for players who want to learn strategy, test variance, or just roll the dice in peace.

eligible.name: Cyberpunk Neon Survivor
eligible.short_description: A top-down roguelike bullet-hell survivor where you pilot a cybernetic mech-dog against endless swarms of rogue cats. Dash, blast, and stack augments into game-breaking builds across 60 waves, persistent nemeses, and epic boss fights — then die, upgrade, and deploy again.

eligible.name: Call of Toys: Tower Defense
eligible.short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey to protect Santa's Valley in this epic Tower Defense game. Explore an arsenal of 13 unique towers, each equipped with magical spells and exclusive abilities. Customize your towers with numerous upgrades that enhance their strength and unlock new magical powers.

eligible.name: Mogitate: Bearing Fruit
eligible.short_description: You're a spirited young man, ready to make the most of a new start! Meet the colorful cast of townsfolk and live your life to the fullest while making friends with all of the people around you!

eligible.name: Add Flyers To Dreams
eligible.short_description: Would you like to run ads in dreams? “ADD FLYERS TO DREAMS” is a flappy roguelike game where you fly around inside dreams, inject ads, stack up contracts, and earn cookies.

eligible.name: Skillful Pixel Dungeon
eligible.short_description: A roguelike RPG refined over 10 years with nearly 1M mobile downloads. Choose from 4 unique classes, explore procedural dungeons, and defeat epic bosses. Every run is different.

eligible.name: Noxcode
eligible.short_description: Reach the TOP by any means possible. Run, jump, climb, fly, or even fall your way up in this chaotic jump quest platformer. Master crazy movement, discover wild shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit!

eligible.name: Panthalassa
eligible.short_description: Panthalassa is a Point and click Puzzle game set in an underwater alien world. You play as an AI reborn in a highly advanced body they do not recognize. Interface with otherworldly technology and unlock the secrets behind this strange planet.

eligible.name: Welcome to Elite Cafe
eligible.short_description: A heart-pounding café management game! Serve customers, cook meals, and invent new menu items — Elite Cafe is busy again today! You can even make your own cookies and drinks. Change outfits and your favorite character becomes the manager?

eligible.name: Iron & Ivory
eligible.short_description: Iron & Ivory is an asymmetric head-to-head VR showdown; you either take command of the submersible as the VR captain or use the desktop and play as the Sea Beast. Battle alone or against your friends and use strategy, reflexes, and stealth to destroy your opponent.

eligible.name: Without A Doubt
eligible.short_description: First dates are awkward. Last dates are awful. A short first-person narrative experience about the beginning and end of a relationship. It's also cheaper than a real date.

eligible.name: Dawn Village
eligible.short_description: A Joseon-era survival strategy game where even goodwill becomes a resource. Manage companions and scarce supplies during a great famine. Every crucial decision is resolved by dice. There are no perfect choices—only surviving today and preparing for tomorrow.

eligible.name: London Train!
eligible.short_description: Run London Trains! Operate the London Underground, overground lines and National Rails!

eligible.name: Congratulations On Your Purchase
eligible.short_description: The most expensive game on Steam. A palace, a red carpet, paparazzi, and a wall where you leave your name — visible to every owner who comes after you. Ten minutes. The price is not a mistake. It is the point.

eligible.name: Midnight Escape
eligible.short_description: A weekend getaway turns into a desperate fight for survival. In Midnight Escape, team up with 3 friends to explore a terrifying villa while hunted by a relentless creature. You must find clues, solve intricate puzzles, and find one of the multiple escape routes before the night claims you all.

eligible.name: WorldShaper Idle
eligible.short_description: Relax and build your own world! Discover new tiles by experimenting with tile placement. Use their bonuses to optimize your production, or just sit back and become ever more powerful! What will your worlds look like?

eligible.name: Frostland
eligible.short_description: Click, collect, build and craft. Frostland is a cozy 2D clicker game set in a snowy valley. Process resources and forge powerful tools to help Pitty, the wizard dog, on his journey to obtain the legendary staff.

eligible.name: It Reaches
eligible.short_description: It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

eligible.name: Penguin Capitalism Simulator
eligible.short_description: Games are too stressful ... so I made one that literally plays itself

eligible.name: Modern Naval Warfare
eligible.short_description: Command the silent service. Modern Naval Warfare is the definitive tactical simulation that puts you inside the pressure hull of a Virginia-Class nuclear submarine. This uncompromising tactical simulation offers unparalleled depth in graphics, physics, and authentic combat systems.

eligible.name: Potion Portion
eligible.short_description: A dopamine-packed idle clicker: stir the cauldron to brew potions, sell them for gold, and unlock witch magic to discover new spells. Step into Grandma's sunlit old potion shop, recover her lost recipes, and rise from novice witch by collecting every potion in the book!

eligible.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
eligible.short_description: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

eligible.name: Tethyscope
eligible.short_description: Explore our planet's ocean to discover animals, plants, and shipwrecks. Take photographs to document your findings and sell them to fund upgrades to your submarine.

eligible.name: Parsector

eligible.name: Rock, Paper, Scissors: Survival
eligible.short_description: Eight warriors from across the world. One ancient game reimagined as a fantasy battle for survival. Wield Rock, Paper, Scissors, or cast devastating Magic. Read your opponent, strike with precision, and fight your way to victory in the ultimate arena showdown.

eligible.name: Thrifty Business

Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

eligible.name: Re:Blade
eligible.short_description: Re:Blade is a cursor-driven incremental action roguelike where every run reshapes your blade and every boss falls to your steps.

eligible.name: Hardware Tycoon
eligible.short_description: From 1986 to 2026, design and engineer the world's most advanced CPUs. Run your own fabs or manufacture for rivals. eligible.name: At Night: Haunted Ride
eligible.short_description: The grand opening of the Haunted Mine Ride is tomorrow. Tonight, you run the final test rides. Ride the minecart, Fix props, repeat rides and don’t make "them" notice you.

eligible.name: Crush The Rebellion!
eligible.short_description: The galactic empire is under siege from the rebel scum in all directions! Fight through endless waves of rebel ships using all of the weapons and resources at your disposal as you execute your sole orders: to Crush The Rebellion!

eligible.name: Corsairs - Battle of the Caribbean

eligible.name: Modern Artillery Strike
eligible.short_description: Turn-based artillery strategy game featuring units inspired by D-30, Grad, Smerch, and more—plan, aim, and strike enemy targets on a stylized battlefield.

eligible.name: Reel & Deal

eligible.name: R-Type Dimensions III
eligible.short_description: Building on the legacy of R-Type Dimensions and R-Type Dimensions EX, Dimensions III has been completely re-envisioned with cutting-edge visuals and sounds, expanded gameplay modes, and a range of new features designed to deliver the most definitive modern edition of R-Type’s classic era.

eligible.name: Earned Today
eligible.short_description: Want to see your earnings tick up every second? Want to feel the rush of money rapidly stacking up on screen? Earned Today brings it to life! Keep your piggy company, earn Carrot Tokens, and collect more piggy styles~

eligible.name: Girls' Dorm -Managing an all-girls' dormitory-

eligible.name: Girls' Dorm -Managing an all-girls' dormitory- After
eligible.short_description: The story isn't over yet! This sequel to Girls' Dorm follows the daily lives of this troublesome trio at Sakuraba Girls' Academy.

eligible.name: Cubical World
eligible.short_description: This is a cube-based survival sandbox. You place cubes break cubes ad experience a procedurally generated world. Do whatever YOU wish to do. Build a house or a statue. Fight ants sheep zombies and survive through the night. Play regular world generation or try islands or flat. There is lots to do...

eligible.name: Hello Duck
eligible.short_description: A cozy idle desktop game where a little duck eats grass, lays eggs, earns coins, and lives a lazy life on a tiny floating island.

eligible.name: 事務所4649(Office4649)

eligible.name: Rogue Quest

eligible.name: Bird Cage
eligible.short_description: You are a bird, stuck in a cage.  No challenge is greater than freeing the bird. Every jump, every fall, every failure is on you in this rage platformer. Don't be a chicken. Escape the cage.

eligible.name: Ratalorica
eligible.short_description: Follow GRATS on its journey even while you work or play on your computer. Every click. Every key press. Every action you take fuels GRATS’ power.

eligible.name: Rune Dice

eligible.name: Project: Mist

eligible.name: CoreShot
eligible.short_description: CoreShot is a classic arcade style space shooter, where you pilot the spacecraft HonestWing to destroy the cores of evil. eligible.name: Memories : Silenced
eligible.short_description: A first person psychological horror experience set in a quiet suburban home. Witness a violent crime, uncover unsettling events, and endure a night where fear slowly takes over familiar spaces. Explore a grounded environment where tension builds through atmosphere and subtle storytelling.

eligible.name: Trees Inc
eligible.short_description: Build a self-sustaining forest in this incremental idle game where you chop trees, automate production with workers, stack upgrades for exponential growth, and use prestige and XP-based perks to push your output further every run.

eligible.name: Winnie-the-Pooh Hops for Honey

eligible.name: Psalm 2
eligible.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where the elevator is the only safe place. On each floor a new reality. On each floor a new resident. Find them to continue your descent downward.

eligible.name: Mob Marathon

eligible.name: PopVibe

eligible.name: Pain Pain Go Away!

eligible.name: Giraffe Champion: The Rock Music Game
eligible.short_description: Play Guitar to Great Rock Songs! Play Cool Guitars and unlock guitars like The Epic Rock Guitar, or the cool Heavy Metal Guitar Design your guitar and play in a cool concert arena. Compete in the epic Guitar Battle!

eligible.name: Dice Have No Eyes
eligible.short_description: ★ Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed ★ Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

eligible.name: Voice of Belldona
eligible.short_description: A sci-fantasy roguelite deckbuilder set in a world collapsing under cosmic instability. To stop the turmoil, humanity created a white-haired, godlike girl with overwhelming power and social anxiety. Enter the Vortex Zone, summon your allies, form your battle line, and tear through the enemy forces.

eligible.name: Creature Caretaker
eligible.short_description: Creature Caretaker is a virtual pet simulator. Hatch your creature from an egg, and help it build a career, make friends, grow a garden, and express itself through music. eligible.name: Server Farm Idle

eligible.name: Beat Your Boss

eligible.name: Rangedrifter

eligible.name: DRYN: Don't Reveal Your Next

eligible.name: Last Crown Gambit

eligible.name: Sporbs
eligible.short_description: A relaxing incremental game where you harvest resources from unique alien organisms. Upgrade your extraction technology, discover unique abilities, manage resources, automate a factory and unlock new areas to maximise your yield.

eligible.name: The Rake Sees You

eligible.name: NukeMark

eligible.name: Vibralizer
eligible.short_description: A next-generation music visualizer for the streaming age. Play music on any platform, then click over to Vibralizer for real-time, high-quality audiovisual immersion. All art is hand-crafted and uses no AI-generated imagery.

eligible.name: Phonopolis

eligible.name: Grill Girl

eligible.name: A Dogday Odyssey

eligible.name: A Factory Roguelike

eligible.name: Éclaircies

eligible.name: P-PAN
eligible.short_description: Armed with a big smile and punches that fly endlessly,have fun progressing! P-PAN can fly and hovering,so even if you're not good at play jumping action,this 2D action shooting game has simple controls that can enjoy.

eligible.name: Thick As Thieves

eligible.name: GooNECT√2

eligible.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
eligible.short_description: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. eligible.name: 007 First Light
eligible.short_description: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

eligible.name: Space Haven

eligible.name: Directive 8020

eligible.name: Blades of Fire

eligible.name: MOTORSLICE
